solutions.name: Lead Flow Reliability Audit
solutions.plain_problem: Leads are duplicated, routed to the wrong person, contacted twice, or silently fail to reach the CRM.

solutions.name: Invoice & Payment Sync Audit
solutions.plain_problem: CRM, Stripe and QuickBooks/Xero disagree about customers, invoices or payment status.

solutions.name: AI Workflow Guardrails Audit
solutions.plain_problem: AI output is inconsistent or wrong but still flows into CRM, finance, email or customer-facing actions.

solutions.name: Client Onboarding Reliability Audit
solutions.plain_problem: A new customer is created in some systems but missing from others, or onboarding steps happen twice or not at all.

solutions.name: Automation Release QA
solutions.plain_problem: A workflow is about to be handed over or reused, but nobody independently tested retries, failures and recovery.
